name: Halloumi
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as it's naturally low in lactose due to the cheese-making process and high salt content.
preparationTips: Slice and pan-fry or grill for best texture
Pat dry before cooking to reduce oil splatter
Don't overcook as it becomes rubbery
Can be eaten cold in salads
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like mint or parsley
